description: Remove one outcome from the link it is in. The outcome and its document stay as they are. A link left with one outcome is removed too. Use it when the reader says two linked outcomes are not the same. Needs the owner or editor role.

documentId.description: The document that holds the outcome.

entityId.description: The outcome id inside that document, from spaces_list_outcomes.

name: spaces_unlink_outcome
title: Take an outcome out of its link
